name: Ringer
author: Fred Nix
description: Your iPhone on the Omarchy bar: click to open its screen as a window you can tap, type and swipe on. Shows whether the phone is connected.

barWidget.description: Click the phone to open your iPhone's screen. Right-click for status and the Stop button.

schema.label: Status check interval
schema.description: Seconds between checks for the phone and the Ringer services. The check is three cheap local commands.

schema.label: Switch off after the window closes
schema.description: Seconds after the phone window is closed before Ringer switches everything off, including the engine on the Mac, so the phone's screen link and any virtual keyboard are released. 0 keeps it running.
